problem_description: Compute the average force exterted by particles in the x-direction, and y-direction for a system of particles (361) arranged initially on a hexagonal lattice with a reduced number density of 0.85 (in reduced unit) in a rectangular simulation box of 50*20 in reduced unit. A circular cluster of particles with diameter 20 (in reduced unit) was created within the simulation box. Periodic boundary conditions are applied in the z-direction, while non-periodic boundary conditions are applied in the x and y directions. The particles interact via a Lennard-Jones potential with a parameters of ϵ=10.0 and σ=1.0, and a cutoff distance of 2.5σ. The system is evolved in the NVE enseble using a time step of 0.001 in reduced LJ units. Initial velocities were assigned corresponding to a temperature of 0.5 and an uniform velocity component v_x = 5 and v_y =2 was imposed on all particles. To confine the particles, repulsive walls were applied along the x and y directions using 9-3 LJ potentials with parameters (epsilon =1, sigma = 1, and cutoff=2.5). The simulation should run for a total of 1,00,000 timesteps.
